# Out-of-Band Management: References

Always prefer current vendor documentation for the exact controller generation and firmware. Port tables,
default-credential policies, and support dates differ by generation. Re-verify links and contents when
updating this skill; record the date checked.

Last verified: 2026-10-31

## Vendor (authoritative)

- Dell iDRAC
  - Default username and password by server generation (unique label password vs. legacy default):
    https://www.dell.com/support/kbdoc/en-us/000133536
  - iDRAC9 Security Configuration Guide:
    https://www.dell.com/support/manuals/en-us/idrac9-lifecycle-controller-v4.x-series/idrac9_security_configuration_guide
  - Dell security advisories: https://www.dell.com/support/security/
- HPE iLO
  - Changing the factory-generated iLO Administrator password (factory tag, Redfish):
    https://servermanagementportal.ext.hpe.com/docs/references_and_material/blogposts/etc/changefactorypasswd/changefactorypasswd
  - HPE server management portal (iLO Redfish and iLOrest documentation):
    https://servermanagementportal.ext.hpe.com/
  - HPE security bulletin library: https://support.hpe.com/connect/s/securitybulletinlibrary
- Supermicro
  - BMC unique password policy and guide: https://www.supermicro.com/en/support/BMC_Unique_Password
  - Supermicro security center (advisories): https://www.supermicro.com/en/support/security_center
- Intel AMT / vPro / CSME
  - Intel AMT manageability ports (TLS ports required; non-TLS ports deprecated):
    https://software.intel.com/sites/manageability/AMT_Implementation_and_Reference_Guide/WordDocuments/manageabilityports.htm
  - Intel SCS end of life and replacement by Intel EMA:
    https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support/articles/000058552.html
  - Intel non-TLS deprecation notice for AMT and Standard Manageability:
    https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support/articles/000089852/technologies/intel-active-management-technology-intel-amt.html
  - Intel Product Security Center (advisories, including CSME/AMT):
    https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/security-center/default.html
  - Open AMT Cloud Toolkit (RPC `amtinfo`): https://device-management-toolkit.github.io/docs/
- Standards and government guidance
  - DMTF Redfish standard: https://www.dmtf.org/standards/redfish
  - CISA and NSA, "Harden Baseboard Management Controllers" (June 2023):
    https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2023/06/14/cisa-and-nsa-release-joint-guidance-hardening-baseboard-management-controllers-bmcs
  - CISA alert on IPMI risks (RAKP, cipher 0, anonymous access):
    https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2013/07/26/risks-using-intelligent-platform-management-interface-ipmi
  - `ipmitool` manual page: https://linux.die.net/man/1/ipmitool

Generic vulnerability and incident sources (CISA KEV, NVD, CVE, CISA ransomware guidance, IC3) are listed in
the core documents.

## Third-party (not authoritative)

- SANS ISC diary on INTEL-SA-00075 and the AMT port list: https://isc.sans.edu/diary/22364
  Historical context for why AMT ports matter; check Intel's current advisories for applicability.
- Thomas-Krenn wiki on the Supermicro BMC unique password:
  https://www.thomas-krenn.com/en/wiki/Information_about_the_BMC_Unique_Password_at_Thomas-Krenn-Servers
  Reseller notes on which board generations carry the label password; confirm against Supermicro.

## Not verified when writing this skill

  lifecycle pages for the specific model.
- Exact console and virtual-media port numbers for each generation: check the vendor port table.
- Whether Intel EMA itself has an announced end of life: check Intel's support pages.
